image_feature_sections.title: Shape Features
image_feature_sections.description: Geometry, contour, density, and structural complexity features that describe the icon body.

features.label: Foreground area ratio
features.meaning: How much of the canvas is occupied by visible foreground pixels.
visual_category_labels: sparse icon, dense icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape because foreground area describes the amount of visible shape material.

features.label: Connected components
features.meaning: How many separated foreground parts the icon contains.
visual_category_labels: single-object symbol, multi-component symbol
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape because separated parts change the icon's object structure.

features.label: Quadtree leaf count
features.meaning: How many spatial subdivisions are needed to describe the foreground pattern.
visual_category_labels: simple icon, complex icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape because more spatial subdivisions indicate more structural shape detail.

features.label: Quadtree structural variability
features.meaning: How unevenly structure is distributed across the icon.
visual_category_labels: simple icon, complex icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape because uneven spatial structure changes visual complexity.

features.label: Quadtree mean leaf size
features.meaning: Average quadtree region size; smaller values imply more localized detail.
visual_category_labels: simple icon, complex icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape because smaller regions indicate finer structural shape detail.

features.label: Bounding-box occupancy
features.meaning: How densely the icon fills its active bounding box.
visual_category_labels: sparse icon, dense icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape because it measures how tightly the visible form fills its active shape area.

features.label: Bounding-box aspect ratio
features.meaning: Whether the active icon shape is tall, wide, or square-like.
visual_category_labels: compact icon, tall icon, wide icon, fragmented icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape because it captures whether the icon's form is tall, wide, or square.

features.label: Solidity
features.meaning: How compactly the foreground fills its outer convex envelope.
visual_category_labels: compact icon, tall icon, wide icon, fragmented icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape because compactness versus gaps changes the perceived silhouette.

features.label: Contour count
features.meaning: How many contour boundaries are present.
visual_category_labels: single-object symbol, multi-component symbol
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape because contours describe the number of visible shape boundaries.

features.label: Holes count
features.meaning: How many enclosed empty spaces appear inside foreground shapes.
visual_category_labels: closed-shape icon, open-line icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape because enclosed empty regions are part of the icon's internal structure.

features.label: Closed-contour ratio
features.meaning: How strongly the icon is composed of closed shapes.
visual_category_labels: closed-shape icon, open-line icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape because closure describes whether the icon is built from enclosed forms.

image_feature_sections.title: Color Features
image_feature_sections.description: Color presence, richness, saturation, and foreground-background contrast.

features.label: Monochrome flag
features.meaning: Whether the icon is effectively black-and-white or grayscale.
visual_category_labels: monochrome icon, colored icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Color because it tells whether color is available as a visual channel.

features.label: Color count
features.meaning: Approximate number of distinct foreground colors.
visual_category_labels: monochrome icon, colored icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Color because it measures how many distinct colors help distinguish the icon.

features.label: Mean saturation
features.meaning: Average foreground color saturation.
visual_category_labels: muted icon, vivid icon, emoji-like icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Color because saturation describes how vivid or muted the icon colors are.

features.label: Colorfulness
features.meaning: Overall richness and variation of foreground colors.
visual_category_labels: muted icon, vivid icon, emoji-like icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Color because it summarizes overall color richness and variation.

features.label: Foreground-background contrast
features.meaning: How strongly the foreground separates from its background.
visual_category_labels: high-contrast icon, low-contrast icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Color because contrast describes foreground-background separation and legibility.

image_feature_sections.title: Style Features
image_feature_sections.description: Measured rendering style: edge load, outline-vs-fill behavior, symmetry, and dominant line direction.

features.label: Edge density
features.meaning: How much edge/detail structure appears in the icon.
visual_category_labels: simple icon, complex icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Style because edge load reflects rendering detail and line-art feel.

features.label: Perimeter-area ratio
features.meaning: How much boundary length exists relative to filled area.
visual_category_labels: filled pictogram, outline icon, line icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Style because boundary-heavy icons often read as outline or line style.

features.label: Filled-vs-outline proxy
features.meaning: Whether the icon behaves more like a filled mark or an outline/line drawing.
visual_category_labels: filled pictogram, outline icon, line icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Style because it directly separates filled marks from outline-like rendering.

features.label: Horizontal symmetry
features.meaning: How balanced the icon is across the left-right axis.
visual_category_labels: symmetric icon, asymmetric icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Style because visual balance is a design-style property.

features.label: Vertical symmetry
features.meaning: How balanced the icon is across the top-bottom axis.
visual_category_labels: symmetric icon, asymmetric icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Style because top-bottom balance affects the icon's visual style.

features.label: Horizontal line orientation
features.meaning: Share of detected line structure that is mostly horizontal.
visual_category_labels: horizontal icon, vertical icon, diagonal/action icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Style because dominant horizontal strokes describe rendering direction.

features.label: Diagonal 45 degree orientation
features.meaning: Share of detected line structure that follows a 45 degree diagonal.
visual_category_labels: horizontal icon, vertical icon, diagonal/action icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Style because diagonal strokes often signal action, motion, or angular rendering.

features.label: Vertical line orientation
features.meaning: Share of detected line structure that is mostly vertical.
visual_category_labels: horizontal icon, vertical icon, diagonal/action icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Style because vertical strokes describe the icon's directional rendering.

features.label: Diagonal 135 degree orientation
features.meaning: Share of detected line structure that follows a 135 degree diagonal.
visual_category_labels: horizontal icon, vertical icon, diagonal/action icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Style because diagonal strokes describe the icon's angular rendering.

features.label: Center offset
features.meaning: How far the icon's visual mass is from the canvas center.
visual_category_labels: centered icon, off-center icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Spatial Layout because it measures where visual mass sits on the canvas.

features.label: Grid foreground r1 c1
